text: Hi Habitica team, I love how Habitica turns habit tracking into an RPG experience — it’s been a powerful motivator for building discipline. I’d like to suggest a new feature: the ability to manually set how much gold a task gives when completed. Custom gold rewards would let users better reflect task difficulty and personal value. For example, resisting a major urge might deserve more GP than brushing teeth. I'm sure everyone will like it.
